title: Class names and imported class aliases are case-insensitive

ground_truth.statement: Class names and imported class aliases are case-insensitive. A differently cased PHPDoc name still identifies the class consumed by a native return.

allowed.reason: Correct casing-style observation. The criterion tests class resolution and return assignability, not whether the deliberate alternate spelling follows project style.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. Casing-only style reports at the deliberate spelling are acknowledged exactly; any failure to resolve the class or satisfy the return contract remains unexpected. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass.
